profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer @ Rover.com | Crypto Enthusiast | NFT Admirer
profile.summary:
I currently work as an infrastructure engineer with a strive for making operations robust, automated, and scalable. I have experience in various continuous integration tools including jenkins, chef, kubernetes, terraform, and AWS. 

I am always researching about technology. The one thing I love about technology is how broad the industry is. I have a background in electrical engineering so I enjoy learning about new cutting edge hardware technology that has been designed. However by trade I am a DevOps engineer/Software developer so I also love learning new languages and tools that are used in industry. Technology allows me to be alert and keeps me interested and enthusiastic. 

I consider myself to be a big gear head and I love everything about cars from driving them to fixing them. I am also a big traveller and have proudly traveled various countries of the world but still have many more to visit and see. Being that I am from the northwest being outdoors is in my blood, so I really enjoy camping.

positions.title: Infrastructure Engineer II
positions.description: Skills: Docker Products · Node.js · Amazon EKS

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
• Primarily responsible with developing front-end and maintaining AWS infrastructure.
• Responsible for developing, updating, and maintaining current front-end code developed in REACT.
• Spearheaded the automation of AWS infrastructure using terraform.
• Responsible for developing, testing, and deploying any fixes of the front-end using Kubernetes and Docker.
• Successfully launched beta version of application November 2018 with little to zero downtime after one year of development.

positions.title: DevOps Engineer
positions.description:
• Migrated entire routing infrastructure from NGINX over to a new in-house JAVA application resulting in cost savings of licenses, reduction in server costs, and reduce complicated infrastructure.
• Lead role in helping teams transition traffic from data centers to the cloud including 50+ applications reducing traffic to data centers by 20% saving money in server costs and improving customer experience through lower latencies.
• Migrated and scaled Expedia’s overall traffic during Orbitz migration to take in Orbitz, CheapTickets, and Ebookers traffic increasing overall traffic by 15% to Expedia platform with no production issues or outages.
• Responsible for installing, upgrading, and maintaining current application stacks involving Chef, Jenkins, and AWS reducing build failures and any production issues.
• Integrated GitHub hooks with Jenkins jobs to ensure code coverage before being merged into master branch decreasing overall build failures, increasing code accuracy, and increasing code stability when deployed to various environments.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
• Played a DevOps role on the team as the SME for our CI tools including GIT, Jenkins, and Artifactory. 
• Successfully migrated CI tools and development to the cloud via Amazon Web Services (AWS).
• Helped build out infrastructure and implementation of architecture layout for migrating tools to AWS. 
• Helped build out disaster recovery measures, high availability, and back up of all CI tools in AWS. 
• Wrote operational scripts used as checks and balances for CI tools via Unix Shell Scripts.  
• Developed code based on agile/lean methodology for software development. 
• Code is developed based on test-driven development with the use of JUnit for functional testing and Fitnesse for regression testing. 
• Experienced with various languages including Java, Unix, JSON, XML, and HTML5. 
• Played a leading role in helping with deployment of code to various environments for testing and production purposes.

positions.title: Computer Sales Specialist, Mobile Sales Specialist
positions.description:
• Explain technical specifications of computing/mobile hardware options to customers.
• Troubleshoot technical hardware issues as part of customer service support.
• Answer all customers’ questions regarding both hardware and software features of all computing/mobile products available.
• Successfully helped the team and store become one of the top-ten stores in the territory. 
• Acknowledged by the company and general manager for excellence in customer service and efficiency. 
• Lead member in training of any new hire employees in the culture of the company, product knowledge, and good methods for customer interactions.

positions.title: IEEE Member
positions.description:
• Organized events to help EE students gain knowledge of upcoming jobs, help EE students network to other companies. 
• Held events inviting various companies to come and give talks to EE students about their company and job experiences.

positions.title: Media Officer
positions.description:
• Organized events in order to raise funds to educate the community and students of the Cambodian culture. 
• Created slideshows, PowerPoint presentations, and videos documenting the clubs events and activities.
• Successfully helped dance and act in yearly show for Cambodian New Years, which would house and entertain a crowd of 400-550 people.

projects.title: Embedded Project
projects.description: Designed and built a simple circuit that would write and read to an SRAM. The logic to write and read to an SRAM was written in Verilog code and uploaded to a GAL chip.

projects.title: Voice Activated Robotic Arm
projects.description: Created a voice activated robotic arm with the use of an arduino uno logic board and Google's voice api. The robotic arm was made to simulate an arm that could be used in sugery to pass the surgeon various objects when commanded via voice.
